&nbsp;Job Position: Marketing and Sales Executive

Job Location: Lagos, and Anambra
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	DemyHealth Limited is looking for a highly motivated and results-driven Marketing and Sales Executive to join our growing team.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving business growth by promoting our diagnostic and laboratory services, building strategic partnerships, generating new business opportunities, and maintaining strong client relationships.
	This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about sales, healthcare marketing, and delivering measurable results.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and develop new business opportunities.
	Build and maintain relationships with hospitals, clinics, laboratories, HMOs, corporate organizations, and healthcare professionals.
	Promote DemyHealth&#39;s diagnostic and laboratory services to prospective clients.
	Conduct regular client visits, presentations, and follow up meetings.
	Negotiate and close business opportunities to achieve monthly sales targets.


Marketing:


	Execute marketing strategies to increase brand visibility and market penetration.
	Represent the company at conferences, exhibitions, health outreaches, and networking events.
	Gather market intelligence and provide feedback on industry trends and competitor activities.
	Support the planning and execution of promotional campaigns.


Reporting:


	Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly activity reports.
	Maintain accurate records of client engagements, sales activities, and business opportunities.
	Provide regular updates on pipeline development and target achievement.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Medical Laboratory Science, Biological Sciences, Public Health, or a related field.
	Minimum of two years of experience in marketing, sales, or business development.
	Experience within the healthcare, diagnostics, pharmaceutical, or medical laboratory industry is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
	Strong relationship management and customer engagement skills.
	Ability to work independently and consistently achieve sales targets.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.


What We Offer


	N150,000 / Month (plus 50k data and transport allowance)
	Competitive salary.
	Performance-based incentives.
	Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
	A dynamic and collaborative work environment.
	Opportunity to contribute to one of Nigeria&#39;s leading diagnostic and healthcare organizations.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: hr@demyhealth.com CC: demyhealthhq@gmail.com using &quot;Application for Marketing and Sales Executive&quot; as the subject of the email.

Fleet Management Team Lead Job at Stanbic IBTC Bank




        
    

        
        Stanbic IBTC Bank is a leading African banking group focused on emerging markets globally. It has been a mainstay of South Africa's financial system for 150 years, and now spans 16 countries across the African continent.

Standard Bank is a firm believer in technical innovation, to help us guarantee exceptional client service and leading edge financial solutions. Our growing global success reflects our commitment to the latest solutions, the best people, and a uniquely flexible and vibrant working culture. To help us drive our success into the future, we are looking for resourceful individuals to join our dedicated team at our offices.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Fleet Management Team Lead
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Job Location: Walter Carrington Crescent, Lagos
Job Type: Full-time
Business Segment: Group Functions

Job Description


	To coordinate and manage the bank’s fleet better within the company overall operating policies in line with the budget, marketing and personnel policies.
	To analyze the bank’s fleet operating system against international standard.
	Monitor the quality and efficiency of service provided by the fleet service providers.
	Deployment of dedicated pool vehicles to business unit as required.
	Monitoring of vehicle request from expatriate and staff members.
	Ensure high standard fleet service that project positively the bank’s corporate image through qualitative service from the fleet service provider and drivers.
	Develop and implements short and long term policy designed to ensure compliance to global best practice in fleet management and adhered to national transport policy.
	Monitors changes in the operating environment and act quickly on potential opportunity.
	Ensure efficient and prompt services are delivered to both external and internal customers.
	Analyze data to monitor performance and plan improvements and demand.
	Ensure health and safety regulations are adhered to in areas of supervision and recommend improvements.
	Ensures the effective roll-out of change initiatives through tracking and reporting on projects as well as conducting readiness assessments.


Requirements
Qualifications:


	BSc Management Sciences or related field.
	Relevant professional certification can be an added advantage.


Experience:


	At least 3-4 years of experience in managing fleet unit in any industry.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Checking Things
	Convincing People
	Directing People
	Documenting Facts
	Embracing Change
	Examining Information
	Exploring Possibilities
	Following Procedures
	Interacting with People
	Making Decisions
	Meeting Timescales
	Team Working.


Technical Competencies:


	Call Reporting
	Contact Centre Customer Relationship Management
	Difficult Calls Management
	Electronic Communications & Devices
	Query Resolution
	Risk Identification
	Telephone Caller Handling
	Verbal Communication.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Operations Representative",
  "description": "T40 is an end-to-end digital platform for intercity transportation and logistics services across Africa enabling end users to get the best customer experiences possible while helping Businesses realize more profits from their business operations. We are changing the face of intercity mobility across Africa. We are leading the way in developing world-class digital solutions for stakeholders in the intercity transport segment. Our mission is to provide an open platform that would support easy and cost - efficient digitization of associated ground transportation services in Nigeria and across Africa. Our vision is to become the leading technology partner for Ground transportation stakeholders across Africa supporting operators, travellers, OTAs and other retail partners. We are a fully remote team with colleagues spread across 5 cities in 2 continents and counting. We are looking to grow our team to Support our expanding client base.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Representative

Job Location: Maza-Maza, Iyana-Paja, Jibowu, Ajah - Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

About the Role


	We&#39;re looking for an Operations Rep. based in Lagos to drive customer and business growth for intercity.ng.
	You&#39;ll identify and pursue new sales opportunities, build relationships with customers and transport operators, promote our services, and consistently contribute to our revenue targets.
	This role is ideal for someone who is outgoing, persuasive, target-driven, and comfortable speaking with people both online and offline.


What you&#39;ll do


	Identify and pursue new sales opportunities across Lagos
	Generate leads through direct outreach, referrals, social media, networking, and other channels
	Reach out to prospective customers and businesses to introduce intercity.ng&#39;s products and services
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers
	Understand customer needs and recommend suitable intercity.ng solutions
	Follow up consistently with leads and move prospects through the sales pipeline
	Meet and exceed weekly and monthly sales targets
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, conversations, and sales activities
	Work closely with the operations and marketing teams to improve customer acquisition and retention
	Gather customer feedback and share insights that can improve our products and services
	Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer needs within the Lagos transportation market
	Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, conversions, and revenue performance


Requirements
What we&#39;re looking for:


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Communications, or a related field
	1&ndash;3 years of experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or a related role
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
	Strong customer relationship management skills
	Comfortable making calls, sending messages, conducting meetings, and engaging prospects in person
	Self-motivated, target-driven, and comfortable working with sales KPIs
	Good knowledge of Lagos and its business/customer environment
	Comfortable using CRM, spreadsheets, messaging, and other digital tools
	Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
	Previous experience in transportation, mobility, logistics, travel, fintech, or technology is an advantage


What success looks like:


	Consistently meeting or exceeding monthly sales targets
	Growing the number of active customers and business accounts
	Maintaining a healthy and well-managed sales pipeline
	Converting qualified leads efficiently
	Building strong, long-term customer relationships
	Providing useful market and customer insights to the wider team.


Benefits


	Supportive, collaborative team
	Flexible working hours, remote-first
	Competitive performance-driven environment
	Exposure to modern sales and business tools
	Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving mobility technology company

Operations Representative Job at T40 Technologies




        
    

        
        
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    

T40 is an end-to-end digital platform for intercity transportation and logistics services across Africa enabling end users to get the best customer experiences possible while helping Businesses realize more profits from their business operations. We are changing the face of intercity mobility across Africa. We are leading the way in developing world-class digital solutions for stakeholders in the intercity transport segment. Our mission is to provide an open platform that would support easy and cost - efficient digitization of associated ground transportation services in Nigeria and across Africa. Our vision is to become the leading technology partner for Ground transportation stakeholders across Africa supporting operators, travellers, OTAs and other retail partners. We are a fully remote team with colleagues spread across 5 cities in 2 continents and counting. We are looking to grow our team to Support our expanding client base.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Representative

Job Location: Maza-Maza, Iyana-Paja, Jibowu, Ajah - Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

About the Role


	We're looking for an Operations Rep. based in Lagos to drive customer and business growth for intercity.ng.
	You'll identify and pursue new sales opportunities, build relationships with customers and transport operators, promote our services, and consistently contribute to our revenue targets.
	This role is ideal for someone who is outgoing, persuasive, target-driven, and comfortable speaking with people both online and offline.


What you'll do


	Identify and pursue new sales opportunities across Lagos
	Generate leads through direct outreach, referrals, social media, networking, and other channels
	Reach out to prospective customers and businesses to introduce intercity.ng's products and services
	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers
	Understand customer needs and recommend suitable intercity.ng solutions
	Follow up consistently with leads and move prospects through the sales pipeline
	Meet and exceed weekly and monthly sales targets
	Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, conversations, and sales activities
	Work closely with the operations and marketing teams to improve customer acquisition and retention
	Gather customer feedback and share insights that can improve our products and services
	Monitor competitors, market trends, and customer needs within the Lagos transportation market
	Prepare regular reports on sales activities, pipeline, conversions, and revenue performance


Requirements
What we're looking for:


	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Communications, or a related field
	1–3 years of experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or a related role
	Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
	Strong customer relationship management skills
	Comfortable making calls, sending messages, conducting meetings, and engaging prospects in person
	Self-motivated, target-driven, and comfortable working with sales KPIs
	Good knowledge of Lagos and its business/customer environment
	Comfortable using CRM, spreadsheets, messaging, and other digital tools
	Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
	Previous experience in transportation, mobility, logistics, travel, fintech, or technology is an advantage


What success looks like:


	Consistently meeting or exceeding monthly sales targets
	Growing the number of active customers and business accounts
	Maintaining a healthy and well-managed sales pipeline
	Converting qualified leads efficiently
	Building strong, long-term customer relationships
	Providing useful market and customer insights to the wider team.


Benefits


	Supportive, collaborative team
	Flexible working hours, remote-first
	Competitive performance-driven environment
	Exposure to modern sales and business tools
	Opportunity to grow with a fast-moving mobility technology

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Customer Service Representative

Job Location: Asaba, Delta
